name: Protein language model function benchmarking platform
description: A platform for assessing protein language models on a suite of function-related prediction tasks and aggregating results across models and tasks.
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (AUC/accuracy/F1/Spearman correlation), aggregated into a composite score
reputation: Increasingly used by computational biology groups to benchmark protein language models on function-related prediction tasks; recognized in the protein ML community but not yet universal.
notes: Caveats include potential data contamination (pretraining overlap with test tasks), varying dataset sizes per task, label noise in functional annotations, and task heterogeneity that can make single-score comparisons misleading.
